_readme: 'summary' is the text shown in the pinned scroll section. The other fields are kept for case-study pages and future use.

stages.title: CONCEPT
stages.summary: TREATMENT, STORYBOARDS AND MOOD FILMS THAT TURN YOUR 3D ASSETS INTO A DIRECTED NARRATIVE — BEFORE A SINGLE FRAME IS SHOT
stages.description: Our process begins with deep ideation. We distill raw ideas into a compelling visual narrative, exploring themes, emotional arcs, and structural world-building through detailed storyboarding, visual treatments, and director mood films.

stages.title: PRE-PRODUCTION
stages.summary: LOCATION STRATEGY, STUDIO PLANNING, CASTING, VFX PLANNING AND PRODUCTION DESIGN — ENGINEERED TO MERGE LIVE ACTION WITH YOUR VISUALIZATION
stages.description: Precision planning turns vision into reality. We conduct worldwide location scouting, technical camera lens testing, custom physical stage architecture, talent casting, and meticulous safety choreography.
stages.gear: Arri Lens Test Projector / Artemis Viewfinder / Shot Designer

stages.title: PRODUCTION
stages.summary: DIRECTOR LED SHOOTS — IN STUDIO, ON LOCATION, OR HYBRID | PRECISION CHOREOGRAPHY DESIGNED TO MERGE SEAMLESSLY WITH ARCHITECTURAL VISUALIZATION
stages.description: On set, every frame is executed with surgical intent. Our elite camera crews, gaffers, and operators command large-format digital cinema bodies, 35mm film cameras, high-speed robotic arms, and high-intensity lighting packages.
stages.gear: Arri Alexa 35 / Phantom Flex 4K / Bolt High-Speed Robot / Cooke Anamorphics

stages.title: POST-PRODUCTION
stages.summary: EDITING, SOUND DESIGN, AND FINAL CINEMATIC POLISH. THE 3D RENDERING STAYS WITH YOUR STUDIO — WE DIRECT THE NARRATIVE AND THE FINAL ASSEMBLY
stages.description: In the finishing suites, the film finds its ultimate soul. Offline rhythmic editing, photorealistic Houdini VFX simulations, DaVinci Resolve film stock color grading, and custom spatial audio mastering.
stages.gear: DaVinci Resolve Studio / Nuke Studio / Houdini 20.5 / Pro Tools HDX
